about: Everything you can own in the game (#9 base, Nov 15): the currencies, items by kind, keepsakes. Read by api/lib/inventory.php and js/core/inventory.js. A new thing is one more entry here. Rules (tested): every id the progression service can hand out (pools, signature lists, story grants, worn buffs) has an entry; keepsakes are memories made physical: never sold, never spent, one of each (owner Nov 14-15: 'keepsakes are items'; how they work beyond that is still open); a currency is never an item. Names and lines are ours. Entries marked sample stand in until the real activities exist. 'sell' says whether the shop may buy it (prices come with the shop). 'tier' is the material tier (1 = common … 6 = the rarest), which caps crafting quality later.

credits.name: Credits
credits.line: The city's money. Everyone needs them; nobody has enough.

materials.name: Materials
materials.line: Common building stock: planks, bolts, sheet metal. What harbor upgrades eat.

salvage_sigils.name: Salvage Sigils
salvage_sigils.line: Stamped tokens the salvage guilds trade in. Proof you found something worth finding.

whispers.name: Whispers
whispers.line: Secrets, rumors and favors owed. Some doors only open for the right whisper.

citizen_pass.name: Citizen Pass points
citizen_pass.line: Points on the pass everyone has to carry. Terms may update at any time.

keepsake.name: Keepsakes
keepsake.line: Memories made physical. Never sold, never spent; one of each.

gift_ribbon.name: The ribbon you gave her
gift_ribbon.line: She tied it on wrong on purpose. Then fixed it when she thought you weren't looking.

gift_clip.name: The hair clip you gave her
gift_clip.line: "It pinches." She hasn't taken it off since.

gift_bolt_ring.name: The bolt you bent into a ring
gift_bolt_ring.line: "It's a bolt." A pause. "...It's my bolt."

photo_first.name: Her first photo of you
photo_first.line: Mostly her thumb. You're in the corner, probably.

photo_steering.name: "I'm steering."
photo_steering.line: Her at the tiller, chin up, pretending not to pose.

fisher_lure.name: The old fisherman's lure
fisher_lure.line: Hand-tied. He said it has never caught anything and that's why it's lucky.

group_doodle.name: Everyone so far, by her
group_doodle.line: She drew everyone you've met. Al is facing the wrong way. "Accurate," she says.

hand_map.name: Her hand-drawn map
hand_map.line: Every place you've been, in her handwriting. The scrapyard is labelled "where I'm from (unfortunately)".

stabilizer_coil.name: A stabilizer coil
stabilizer_coil.line: Scorched, but the right kind. It stopped the whine in her leg.

part_common.name: Loose parts
part_common.line: Screws, springs and a wire or two. Always useful.

part_good.name: Good parts
part_good.line: Parts that still work. Rarer than they should be.

part_rare.name: A rare part
part_rare.line: Somebody stopped making these a long time ago.

gift_nice.name: A nice gift
gift_nice.line: The kind of gift people remember.

furniture_piece.name: A piece of furniture
furniture_piece.line: For the house, once there's a room for it.

outfit_piece.name: Something to wear
outfit_piece.line: Clothes, for her or for you.

delve_greatsword.name: A greatsword from the deep
delve_greatsword.line: Far too big, far too old, far too good to leave behind.

delve_map_scrap.name: A scrap of an old map
delve_map_scrap.line: Half a corridor and a word nobody can read yet.

delve_old_servo.name: An old servo
delve_old_servo.line: Pre-crash work. She looks at it like it's a puppy.

drone_rare_part.name: A rare drone part
drone_rare_part.line: The drone was very proud of this one.

fish_small_catch.name: A small catch
fish_small_catch.line: Dinner, or bait for a bigger one.

fish_legend.name: A fish of legend
fish_legend.line: Nobody will believe you. Good thing she was there.

tinker_spare_gear.name: A spare gear
tinker_spare_gear.line: Every workbench has a jar of these.

tinker_tuned_part.name: A tuned part
tinker_tuned_part.line: It hums a little better than it should.

tinker_prototype.name: A prototype
tinker_prototype.line: It works. Mostly. Don't shake it.

focus_blue_light_glasses.name: Blue-light glasses
focus_blue_light_glasses.line: Easy on the eyes. She says they suit you.

moonlight_greatsword.name: A greatsword of pale steel
moonlight_greatsword.line: A gift from a general's own collection.

fish_odd_bottle.name: A bottle with a note inside
fish_odd_bottle.line: The note is smudged. She says it's a love letter. It might be a receipt.

focus_sticky_note.name: A sticky note from her
focus_sticky_note.line: "You did good today." Drawn underneath: a very small robot.

generals_medal.name: The general's medal
generals_medal.line: He pinned it on you himself, over dinner.
